a9150611b362e294.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاديب للخدمات اللوجستية عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تنفيذ ومراقبة إجراءات وسياسات الموارد البشرية المتعلقة بدوام الموظفين، الإجازات، وتحديث البيانات، بالإضافة إلى التعامل مع استفسارات وشكاوى الموظفين. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم بأنواعها المختلفة، وتعديل النماذج حسب الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية، المرضية، الطارئة، وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات، الإعارة، وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بمهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة عند الضرورة. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويدها لفريق خدمات الموظفين، من خلال تسجيل وتوثيق كافة البيانات مثل الترقيات، الدورات التدريبية، والأمور المتعلقة بالرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية. فهم عميق لإجراءات وأنظمة وسياسات الموارد البشرية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمليات الموارد البشرية في مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع الموظفين والإدارات المختلفة لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة وفعالية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة الاديب للخدمات اللوجستية.

a9d43a377cf04d19.description: نبحث عن مصفف شعر (كوافير) مبدع وموهوب للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في تقديم تجربة استثنائية لعملائنا. ستكون مسؤولاً عن تقديم مجموعة واسعة من خدمات تصفيف الشعر والعناية به، مع الالتزام بأعلى معايير الجودة والاحترافية. إذا كنت تمتلك شغفًا بالجمال، ومهارات فنية عالية، وقدرة على فهم احتياجات العملاء، فنحن ندعوك للتقدم لهذه الفرصة. المهام والمسؤوليات: * تقديم خدمات تصفيف الشعر المتنوعة بما في ذلك القص، التلوين، التسريحات، والعلاجات. * تقديم استشارات للعملاء حول تسريحات الشعر المناسبة لأنواع شعرهم وأشكال وجوههم. * الاهتمام بنظافة وترتيب مكان العمل والمحافظة على أدوات العمل. * مواكبة أحدث صيحات الموضة والتقنيات في مجال تصفيف الشعر.

a9cdce359bb2711c.description: About the Role **** is seeking a Manager - Sales to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on developing, managing, and growing relationships with key accounts within the travel industry. Key Responsibilities Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned key accounts, handling all client commercial inquiries. Develop deep relationships with decision-makers and influencers within each account to foster loyalty and retention. Conduct regular reviews of clients’ needs, performance metrics, and travel patterns to propose tailored solutions. Visit partners regularly during the week to meet them and build rapport with management and agents. Develop and implement strategic account plans to meet or exceed sales targets and revenue goals. Identify and pursue upsell and cross-sell opportunities by promoting additional travel products or services. Monitor market trends, competitors’ activities, and client industry developments to position offerings that match client needs. Facilitate a seamless onboarding experience for new clients, ensuring they are fully trained on using the company’s booking platforms and understanding available services. Organize periodic training sessions for clients on new features, products, and booking solutions. Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows to represent the company, strengthen existing relationships, and establish new connections. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (*, marketing, product, operations) to align on client needs and deliver customized solutions. Analyze sales data, travel trends, and client usage patterns to identify growth opportunities and areas for improvement. Prepare and present regular performance reports for each account, along with actionable insights and recommendations to improve sales and service quality. Maintain accurate records of client interactions, sales activities, and account progress in CRM tools. This role requires excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to strategically align client needs with company offerings. Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant sales or account management role. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia.

a9cde9c15ab2a6ec.description: About the Role National Contracting Co Ltd is seeking a skilled Mobile Crane Operator to join our team in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. Collaborate with site supervisors and team members to coordinate lifts, ensuring effective communication to prevent accidents and facilitate timely project completion. Maintain accurate records of crane operations, including load weights and operational hours, for project reporting and compliance. Assist in the setup and dismantling of crane equipment, ensuring all components are securely installed and operational for each lift. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

a9dbccd0e008938d.description: About the Role NES Global Talent is seeking a Field Specialist II - Tubular Services (TBL) or Tubular Running Services (TRS) Field Supervisor for a contract position based in Dhahran and Dammam. This mid-level technical oilfield role is responsible for the management, maintenance, and operation of tubular equipment on rig floors, supervision of field crews, and ensuring adherence to safety and service quality standards. Key Responsibilities Coordinate and execute the safe makeup, breakout, installation, and running of tubulars, including casing, tubing, and accessories, at onshore or offshore rig sites. Perform hands-on installation, troubleshooting, testing, and routine servicing of TRS equipment both in the shop and on location. Supervise, train, and manage field operators and assistant crews during rig-up, operation, and rig-down tasks. Participate in daily safety meetings, Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs), and toolbox talks, ensuring strict compliance with company and client Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) guidelines. Required Experience and Skills Minimum of 5 to 10 years of hands-on field experience in oil and gas wellsite or tubular running services, with 6 to 8+ years of active field experience on onshore or offshore drilling rigs. Deep proficiency in running casing and tubing strings, operating hydraulic power tongs and CRTi tools, performing rig-up/rig-down operations, torque-turn data monitoring, and executing field equipment maintenance and troubleshooting. Ability to lead teams, act as a primary interface with the client (Company Man), and oversee high-risk, high-cost casing and tubing operations on the rig floor. Proficiency with tools and software related to managing hydraulic power tongs, computerized torque-turn monitoring, and casing drive systems. Qualifications and Certifications Standard industry safety and operational certifications are required. Candidates must meet a specific combination of technical competencies, field safety certifications, and physical requirements. Work Environment This is a contract position involving field operations at onshore or offshore rig sites in the Dhahran and Dammam regions. The role requires active participation in rig-floor operations and adherence to stringent safety protocols. Application Process Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry. Salary information is not disclosed at this time.

a947bc787105781a.description: We are seeking a proactive and organised Customer Service Officer to support logistics and delivery operations within the Supply Chain team. The role is responsible for coordinating daily deliveries between customers, drivers, dispatchers, and logistics personnel, ensuring efficient truck utilisation, timely deliveries, and excellent customer communication. The successful candidate will monitor vehicle movements, confirm customer readiness before dispatch, manage delivery exceptions, and support continuous improvement of logistics performance. Key Responsibilities Truck Movement & GPS Monitoring Monitor daily truck movements through GPS tracking systems. Track departures, arrivals, unloading activities, and truck returns. Identify delayed, stationary, or route-deviating vehicles. Follow up with drivers regarding delays and operational issues. Escalate significant delays, breakdowns, or route issues to relevant stakeholders. Trip Turnaround Time Control Monitor delivery trips against agreed turnaround times. Maintain records of delays and recurring issues. Analyse delay trends and recommend corrective actions to improve fleet utilisation. Customer Delivery Confirmation Contact customers prior to dispatch to confirm delivery readiness. Verify storage and silo capacity before releasing deliveries. Confirm delivery schedules and manage postponement requests. Communicate customer requirements and restrictions to logistics teams. Prevent unnecessary dispatches to customers unable to receive deliveries. Customer & Driver Coordination Serve as the primary coordination point between customers, drivers, dispatchers, and logistics teams. Keep customers informed of delivery schedules and significant delays. Communicate customer instructions and delivery requirements to drivers. Assist in resolving delivery-related customer concerns. Daily Logistics Coordination Support execution of daily dispatch and delivery plans. Coordinate truck availability with delivery schedules. Follow up on delayed, postponed, and rescheduled deliveries. Support optimisation of truck allocation and utilisation. Coordinate with Operations, Sales, Maintenance, and third-party logistics providers regarding delivery issues. Ensure delivery documentation and trip records are maintained accurately. Exception Management Proactively identify issues affecting delivery performance, including vehicle breakdowns, unloading delays, storage limitations, and driver availability. Take immediate action to minimise disruption. Escalate unresolved issues to the Logistics Supervisor or Manager. Maintain logs of exceptions, delays, and corrective actions. Reporting & Performance Monitoring Prepare daily and weekly logistics reports covering: Planned versus completed deliveries Truck turnaround times Delayed deliveries Customer-related waiting and unloading delays Postponed or cancelled deliveries Truck utilisation Operational exceptions Identify recurring issues and provide data-driven recommendations for improvement. Education Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred). Experience Proven experience in customer service, logistics operations, logistics coordination, or a similar role. Skills & Competencies Strong coordination skills. Good organisational and problem-solving abilities. Knowledge of logistics operations, transportation processes, and inventory management principles. Good customer service and stakeholder management skills. Ability to communicate effectively with customers, drivers, vendors, and internal teams. High attention to detail and accuracy in record-keeping. Ability to manage priorities in a fast-paced operational environment. Understanding of health and safety practices within logistics and warehouse operations. Proficiency in tracking, reporting, and monitoring operational performance.

This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on identifying new business opportunities, client acquisition, and developing strategic relationships to generate revenue through contracting and project-based work. The successful candidate will manage both independently generated leads and company-provided inquiries. Key Responsibilities Identify, develop, and secure new business opportunities across Saudi Arabia. Generate qualified B2B leads through independent prospecting, networking, market research, and client outreach. Identify upcoming construction, MEP, HVAC, electrical, fire protection, civil contracting, and maintenance projects. Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, procurement managers, project managers, engineering managers, facility managers, and key decision-makers. Build long-term client relationships and identify opportunities for repeat business. Maintain an updated sales pipeline and provide regular business development reports. a9825aae3d30c377.description: About the Role UrbaCon Contracting & Trading Company is seeking a Senior Planning Engineer to oversee and manage planning and scheduling activities for engineering projects. This full-time role involves developing detailed project schedules, coordinating with various departments, and monitoring progress to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget. The Senior Planning Engineer will analyze project requirements, allocate resources, and identify potential risks to optimize project outcomes. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain comprehensive project schedules, incorporating all tasks, milestones, and deliverables. Coordinate with project managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, establish priorities, and define project scope. Monitor project progress against established schedules, identifying deviations, delays, and potential risks, and implementing corrective actions. Conduct regular project status meetings, providing updates on schedule performance, resource utilization, and potential impacts. Analyze project data and performance metrics to identify trends and opportunities for improvement, recommending adjustments to schedules and resource allocation. Collaborate with procurement, logistics, and supply chain teams to ensure timely delivery of materials and resources. Prepare and distribute reports, dashboards, and presentations summarizing project schedules, progress, and performance indicators. Provide guidance, support, and mentorship to junior planning engineers and project teams. Stay updated on industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in project management and scheduling. Ensure compliance with organizational policies, procedures, and quality standards in project scheduling and management. Support the implementation of HSE initiatives, participate in safety awareness activities, and contribute to incident reporting and resolution in alignment with company and IMS policies. Required Experience Candidates should possess 8 years of experience in a relevant planning or engineering role. The ideal candidate will demonstrate a strong understanding of project scheduling principles and project management methodologies. Skills and Attributes Proficiency in developing and maintaining complex project schedules. Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple departments and stakeholders. Strong analytical skills for identifying deviations, risks, and opportunities for improvement. Excellent communication skills for providing project updates and facilitating discussions. Capability to provide mentorship and support to team members. Commitment to continuous improvement and staying informed on industry best practices. Work Environment This is a full-time position within UrbaCon Contracting & Trading Company, where the Senior Planning Engineer will play a critical role in facilitating communication among project stakeholders and ensuring project objectives are met. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this role. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

a92e2499b19ce233.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة سراكو عن حاجتها إلى فني أجهزة طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخفجي. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية متابعة تركيب وتشغيل الأجهزة الطبية، بالإضافة إلى تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية والعلاجية وفقاً لإرشادات الشركات المصنعة. هذا الدور مخصص للعمل بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع مخططات تركيب الأجهزة الطبية المتنوعة، مثل أجهزة غسل الكلى، وأجهزة دعم القلب والتنفس والرئة، وأجهزة التصوير والتخطيط الطبي، وغيرها. تحديد مواقع التركيب المناسبة ومتابعة جميع إجراءات التركيب، مع إعداد قوائم بقطع الغيار الاحتياطية الضرورية. متابعة إجراءات التشغيل التجريبي للأجهزة الطبية والتأكد من تشغيلها وفقاً لأدلة التشغيل المعتمدة. تدريب مستخدمي الأجهزة الطبية على إجراءات التشغيل السليم والضبط الصحيح. تتبع مخططات الدارات الإلكترونية للأجهزة الطبية، وتشخيص الأعطال باستخدام أجهزة الفحص والقياس، وتنفيذ إجراءات الإصلاح والضبط اللازمة. تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة الطبية بدقة، وذلك بحسب التعليمات الصادرة عن الشركة الصانعة. إعداد وتقديم وتوثيق وحفظ تقارير العمل بشكل دوري ومنظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال صيانة وتركيب الأجهزة الطبية. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الفنية والكهربائية للأجهزة الطبية. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات الصيانة الوقائية والعلاجية. مهارات تدريبية لتعليم المستخدمين على تشغيل الأجهزة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الأجهزة الطبية ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة سراكو بالمنطقة الشرقية، مدينة الخفجي. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام ببرامج الصيانة المجدولة والطارئة لضمان استمرارية عمل الأجهزة الطبية بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال مراحل المقابلة.

a931892f680309a1.description: About the Role Salt is seeking an experienced Facilities Manager for an immediate hire in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
